what: extra cells rendered on top of the film to answer two questions the single pass could not

confetti_person_hallucination.question: confetti drew a boy into a keyframe authored no humans. card or seed?

cells.saw: confetti fires; A BOY APPEARS out of a puff of smoke at ~f14 and stays for the rest of the clip
confetti fills the room and settles on the desks. NO PERSON. framing intact
confetti falls steadily. NO PERSON. framing intact

confetti_person_hallucination.verdict: the card fires 3/3 and invents an occupant 1/3. seed-dependent, not a property of the string

hold_all_vs_hold_frame.question: both hold_all beats crept the framing in (19.3 / 15.3) while the hold_frame beat sat at 2.4. is that the CARD or the SHOT?
hold_all_vs_hold_frame.verdict: IT IS THE SHOT. same keyframe, same seed, the two hold strings are indistinguishable (19.3 vs 19.7, 15.3 vs 14.6) and both creep in. last_look_00 sat at 2.4 because it is a flat object on a dark floor, not because hold_frame is the better card. resolve_motion picking hold_all for a person and hold_frame for nobody buys nothing measurable here.
